style: gothic twilight oil painting with silver moonbeams, violet mist, and carved darkstone runes
rules: Each item belongs to a unified tabletop cosmetic collection sharing the exact same palette, brushwork, and motif. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or borders.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Moonlit Coven

items.subject: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Moonlit Coven. A wide 16:9 tabletop playmat with a calm, low-contrast textured center so playing cards read crisply over it, and painterly theme accents along the outer edges.
a painterly fantasy portrait bust of Night Herbalist in the theme of Moonlit Coven. A centered bust portrait medallion subject with dramatic workshop lighting and clean silhouette.

an adorable small magical tabletop companion creature, Shadow Cat, matching Moonlit Coven. A charming tabletop companion creature in full-body view centered with breathing room around it on a deep moody background.
a circular ornamental portrait frame medallion titled Silver Crescent in the style of Moonlit Coven. An ornate circular portrait border motif with clean dark interior so an avatar sits inside it.
an ornate vertical Command-Zone card border frame titled Coven Command matching Moonlit Coven. An ornate vertical rectangular border frame for a commander card slot with a calm dark interior center.

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
